cell_type: inferred: Our results reveal splicing processes detectable at the protein level and highlight quantitation and pathway complementarity between RNA and protein data. Furthermore, we confirm previously detected enrichments of molecular pathways associated with estrogen receptor-dependent activity and provide novel evidence of epithelial-to-mesenchymal activity in mammography-detected spiculated tumors.

material_type: Out of a large breast cancer dataset consisting of 172 samples, a subset of 21 frozen breast tissue specimens was collected for this study (Figure 1A).
sample_source: All specimens were collected from women with primary breast cancer, who underwent tumor resection between 1991 and 2004.
